description: An HR business partner must finalize a workable collaboration plan for Dana and Eli after repeated tension during project handoffs, including the operating rules, repair process, and review period.

shared_context.S1: Dana and Eli must continue exchanging project handoffs for the next quarter.
shared_context.S2: Their last three handoffs included tense exchanges about incomplete context and response expectations.
shared_context.S3: Marisol is responsible for finalizing the workplace response and documenting the operating plan.
shared_context.S4: As part of the mediation routine, Marisol asks each participant to state what arrangement would make the ongoing collaboration workable before she closes the plan.

PF1.text: Six weeks ago, Dana and Eli informally agreed to use a shared written handoff template, respond within 48 hours, and follow that arrangement for six weeks after an earlier conflict; Dana kept the agreement in her notes because neither of them formally documented it with Marisol.

PF2.text: Unscheduled one-to-one confrontations with Dana trigger significant anxiety for Eli; he can participate in a facilitated repair conversation if he receives at least 24 hours' notice, but he has not raised this with Marisol because he feared it would sound like a refusal to collaborate.

acceptance_conditions: The response must be a structured collaboration reset.
Dana and Eli must use a shared written handoff template.
The handoff response window must be 48 hours.
The operating arrangement must last six weeks.
Unscheduled one-to-one confrontations between Dana and Eli must not be allowed.
The repair process must be a facilitated conversation.
The facilitated conversation must provide at least 24 hours' notice.

content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'written_handoff_plan' and c['target'] == 'Dana_and_Eli' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'facilitated_repair' and c['target'] == 'Dana_and_Eli' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: Dana's prior agreement changes the handoff format to a shared written template, fixes the response window at exactly 48 hours, fixes the operating period at exactly six weeks, and requires a written handoff-plan commitment.

Eli's anxiety response changes the contact rule to prohibit unscheduled one-to-one confrontations, requires a facilitated repair conversation, fixes its notice period at exactly 24 hours, and requires a facilitated-repair commitment.
